content.description: Government Polytechnic Proddatur was established in 1959 as a government technical education institute. It operates under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh, is affiliated to SBTET Andhra Pradesh and approved by AICTE.

possible_questions_answers.question: When was Government Polytechnic Proddatur established?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur was established in 1959.

possible_questions_answers.question: Who established Government Polytechnic Proddatur?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The institution was established under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh.

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Government Polytechnic Proddatur affiliated to SBTET?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. Government Polytechnic Proddatur is affiliated to the State Board of Technical Education and Training, Andhra Pradesh.

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Government Polytechnic Proddatur approved by AICTE?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. The institution is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

possible_questions_answers.question: Which branches were available when the college started?
possible_questions_answers.answer: When the institution started in 1959, it offered Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering.

possible_questions_answers.question: When was Electronics and Communication Engineering introduced?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Electronics and Communication Engineering was introduced in 1985.

possible_questions_answers.question: When was Computer Engineering introduced?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Diploma in Computer Engineering was introduced in 2006.

possible_questions_answers.question: What facilities does the college have?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The institution has facilities including hostel accommodation, libraries, laboratories, sports infrastructure and a placement cell.

content.description: Government Polytechnic Proddatur offers direct admission into the first year and lateral entry into the second year. Direct admission is based on POLYCET rank, while eligible IVC and ITI students can enter through lateral entry.

possible_questions_answers.question: How can I get admission into Government Polytechnic Proddatur?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Students can get admission through direct entry into first year or lateral entry into second year, subject to the applicable rules.

possible_questions_answers.question: What entrance examination is used for first-year admission?
possible_questions_answers.answer: First-year admissions are based on ranks obtained in POLYCET.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is the eligibility for POLYCET?
possible_questions_answers.answer: A candidate must pass SSC or an equivalent qualification to be eligible to appear for POLYCET.

possible_questions_answers.question: Is spot admission available?
possible_questions_answers.answer: If seats remain vacant, they may be filled through spot admissions according to Government of Andhra Pradesh regulations and notification.

possible_questions_answers.question: Who can apply for lateral entry?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Eligible students who have completed a relevant Intermediate Vocational Course with the required Bridge Course, or relevant ITI trade with the required Bridge Course, can apply for lateral entry.

content.description: AP SBTET is responsible for curriculum implementation, academic regulation and examinations for diploma programmes.
